Name: Drone Remote Control 0.2.33 - Private Prototype
Description: 0.2.33 - Vehicle/body surface-wait recovery test. Collision classification no longer requires a drone transform accessor. Inactive/recycled native Actor references are absent damage parts rather than whole-scan errors. Dense all-hit results retry a bounded 128-row buffer; partial results never authorize flight. Terrain avoidance and 1cm body clearance remain. Includes 0.2.32 recovery, 100m backpack boundary and 5s overshoot grace. One multilingual runtime supports 14 option languages with English fallback. Assistance and multiplayer default OFF. Bingus Shared Loader API 1 required; Mod Options Menu API 1/version 3+ optional. Offline tests pass; actual vehicle/body contact behavior still needs live testing. Fully exit, replace, deploy and restart.

Options.Name: Backpack and Seeker Control - Private Test
Options.Description: All actions use your configured keyboard/mouse bindings, not fixed hotkeys. Start with the backpack drone docked. Hold Switch Aim Mode and press Use Backpack Function, then release both; Use Backpack Function exits. Outward movement stops at 100m; external overshoot receives 5s to return. Overheating or confirmed empty ammo exits. Seeker: hold Switch Aim Mode and use Quick Throwable / Quick Grenade, then release both; alternatively equip Throwable / Grenade, hold Switch Aim Mode and press then release Fire, then release Switch Aim Mode. Deployment must remain stable for 0.5s before control. A new Fire press detonates; Switch Aim Mode does nothing during control. Explosion view lasts 0.7s. No Seeker range limit; lifetime 30s. Movement, Dive and Crouch follow game bindings. Solo by default; multiplayer unverified. Allow Multiplayer, Auto Aim and Seeker Homing Assist default OFF. Body clearance 1cm. Apply and restart. Log: DroneRemoteControl.log.
